simple.meaning: אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר (ʼeshtaddûwr) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “rebellion.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezra 4:15. The surrounding context includes family, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר (H849) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר (ʼeshtaddûwr) / H849 is traced through Ezra 4:15, Ezra 4:19 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.
